questions.question:
If A denotes 'addition', B denotes 'multiplication', C denotes 'subtraction', and D denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following equation?

15 C 9 A 7 B 2 = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 Means
 +
 × 
 -
 ÷ 
 
 

The given expression : 15 C 9 A 7 B 2 = ?

After interchanging the symbols by mathematical operators the expression is as follows : 15 - 9 + 7 × 2 

= 15 - 9 + __**7 × 2 **__

= __**15**__ - 9 __**+ 14**__ 

= __**29**____** - 9**__

= **20**

 Hence, the correct answer is **"20".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some M are N.

II. No J is N.

**Conclusion:**

I. No N is J.

II. Some N are M.

III. All J are M.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions II and III follows

questions.solution:
Statements:

I. Some M are N.

II. No J is N.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a87462a7f3bac8f8f0f861381c7ace1d3db6c17e8081a3ed61c67c4e6d188d0d.png] 

Conclusion:

I. No N is J. → **Follow** (No J is N, which means No N is J is definitely true)

II. Some N are M. → **Follow** (Some M are N, which means some N are M is definitely true)

III. All J are M. → **Not follow** (Because some M are n and no N is J, which means all J are M is definitely false)

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions I and II follow**".

questions.question: Eight boys Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Ram is the immediate neighbour of both Ramu and Anil. Sanjay is third to the right of Ramu. Ramu is second to the right of Anil. Ram is second to the left of Kamal. Vivek is not the immediate neighbour of Anil. Aakash is second to the right of Ramu. Who is second to the right of Vivek?
questions.solution:
Eight boys **Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu** are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1. Sanjay is third to the right of Ramu. 

2. Ramu is second to the right of Anil.

3. Ram is the immediate neighbour of both Ramu and Anil.

4. Vivek is not the immediate neighbour of Anil. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd94b72492a1cc6b7ec0636daf8ab88bfc7eb55f62896fd6ca24941a58915537.png] 

5. Aakash is second to the right of Ramu.

6. Ram is second to the left of Kamal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64695fe13019f20f3410c37bbba95e3e2a4b82720f047c3c9ef2e3dea89f1a54.png] 

Vivek will occupy the position immediate to the right of Sanjay, as it is the only possible position Vivek can occupy.

And, Rahul is sitting between Anil and Vivek.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bee4db205ca0c44983943d0e18ab5741c3a70da13b19b7f0b617d6ab4f127704.png] 

Clearly, Anil is second to the right of Vivek.

Hence, '**Anil**' is the correct answer.
